description: This PHP class 'Account' in the 'Goteo\Model\Project' namespace manages project-specific account information including methods to retrieve, validate, and save account data, as well as check permissions for payment methods such as PayPal and Stripe.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Model class representing project account details including payment options and account information, capable of retrieving and saving data to the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves account information for a specific project by ID, initializing default values if not present.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the account data, ensuring required fields are set before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the account data into the database, after validation.

methods.name: getAllowpp
methods.description: Checks if PayPal payments are allowed for a specific project.

methods.name: getAllowStripe
methods.description: Checks if Stripe payments are allowed for a specific project.
